person.canonical_name_en: Carl August, Grand Duke of Saxe-Weimar-Eisenach

activity.notes: Carl August's grand-ducal title and rule after the 1815 elevation until his death 1828. His earlier titles/rules are separate: Dukes of Saxe-Weimar and Saxe-Eisenach in personal union since 1758 (under Anna Amalia regency until 1775), consolidated Duchy of Saxe-Weimar-Eisenach 1809–1815. These three earlier political-office records are separately staged in the same PR; do not collapse them into the Grand Duchy or invent polity identities.

sources.title: Klassik Stiftung Weimar — Carl August
sources.citation_text: Born 1757, became personally governing duke in 1775, promoted to Grand Duke in April 1815, died 1828.

sources.title: Rulers.org — German States before 1945
sources.citation_text: Carl August 1758–1809 in Saxe-Weimar/Eisenach personal union, consolidated Duchy from September 1809 and Grand Duchy from April 1815.
